Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results by identifying Al-Ghazali (a theologian, Persian) as the “historian” instead of Ibn Khaldun, who was explicitly described as a Tunisian historian. This premature synthesis ignored the clearer evidence and led to the wrong heritage being reported.
